title: Reduced primary street setback for a portion of the frontage: maximum width of the reduced portion
text: C3.3.2 Notwithstanding C3.3.1, the following reductions are permitted: i. the primary street setback line may be reduced for a portion of the frontage width in accordance with in Table 3.3b (refer Figure 3.3a). Table 3.3b maximum percentage of frontage width (R2 to R40): The greater of: 30% of the frontage width or 4m. Maximum percentage of frontage width excludes garages which are provided in accordance with Table 3.3c.

replaces.note: 30% of frontage -> the greater of 30% or 4 m

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: The formula value is the permitted width; the rule MEETS when the built-forward width is at or under it. Per the Table 3.3b footnote, a garage provided in accordance with Table 3.3c is excluded from the width, so the fact is the width excluding such a garage.

verified.note: Footnote reads 'Maximum percentage of frontage width excludes garages which are provided in accordance with Table 3.3c': a garage that meets Table 3.3c is not counted in the reduced-portion width.
